name: Our Himbo Turned into a Werewolf and This Dead-Beat Dad is Our Only Hope
source:
Halloween has gotten boring for this college-aged trio, so what better way to spice things up than a random, sketchy-looking ritual made by who-knows-who?

When the Twilight hour of Halloween takes a turn for the worst, it’s up to the one and only Magus in the world to solve the problem and save your friend from eternal werewolf-ication. The only problem is, this wizard is… kind of useless.

Can you break this dead-beat Magus out of his funk, and reverse the ritual before it’s too late?

[From [url=https://celadonstudios.itch.io/our-werewolf-himbo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
对于这个大学时代的三人组来说，万圣节已经变得无聊了，所以还有什么比由谁知道的人随机制作的、看起来粗略的仪式更好的方式来给事情增添趣味呢？

当万圣节的黄昏时刻出现最糟糕的情况时，世界上唯一的魔法师就需要解决这个问题，并将你的朋友从永恒的狼人化中拯救出来。唯一的问题是，这个巫师……有点没用。

你能否让这位垂头丧气的魔法师摆脱恐惧，并在为时已晚之前扭转仪式？

[来自[url=https://celadonstudios.itch.io/our-werewolf-himbo]itch.io[/url]]
